Subject: Contract extension + GPU uplift to support XL long-context model and reranker add-on

Hi Emma / Samir,

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Per our call, you want to: 1) extend the term for 24 months, 2) onboard the new XL model for product summaries (32k context) starting in Q3, and 3) add the on-prem reranker add-on to remove upstream latency for search ranking. Those changes will materially increase GPU memory and throughput needs.

I've sketched a proposed commitment bump that keeps your unit pricing close to the current tier while provisioning: +8 H100-equivalent reserved GPUs (higher-memory profile), a dedicated long-context pool to serve the 32k sequences, and a separate small-pool for the reranker with soft throughput guarantees during peak windows.

Attached: a draft SOW addendum and a 24-month throughput/cost projection. Can you confirm procurement contacts and any date constraints for DocuSign? If you approve, I will loop in Karthik (solutions) and Grace (engagement owner) to finalize capacity sizing and SLA language.

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm procurement details and target signature date (we recommend 2027-06-01 to hit Q3 onboarding).
- We finalize SOW and throughput appendix with engineering sizing.
- DocuSign send and implementation kickoff.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Ava Chen

Hi Ava —

Thanks for this summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- We do want 32k context for the XL model, but can phase capacity over two sprints (initial subset of customers in September, full rollout in November).
- The reranker will be used for live search traffic during PST business hours; we need a 95th percentile throughput guarantee for the peak window (roughly 220 qps sustained for 2 hours).
- Procurement prefers a single addendum to the existing master services agreement rather than multiple docs.

Target signature date: week of 2027-06-07 — procurement needs time to review finance terms. Please keep the SOW and pricing consolidated.

Ava / Grace — quick sizing note after a first pass:

- Long-context XL model (32k): to keep token latency within 500–700ms for generation at expected concurrency, recommend dedicating a 4-node high-memory H100 pool (equivalent to ~4 H100-64G profiles). That covers initial phased rollout (Sept) and can be scaled to 6 nodes for full rollout.
- Reranker pool: to meet 95p 220 qps during peak, we need a small dedicated pool of 6 mid-tier GPUs optimized for low-latency batching with pre-warmed KV cache. With aggressive batching and priority preemption we can meet the SLA; without it we'd need 8.
- Ops and autoscale: propose baseline reserved capacity = 10 GPUs (4 high-memory + 6 mid-tier). Add a 2-GPU burst buffer that can be used for short spikes (billing at burst rate). That totals 12 reserved with 2 burst.

Implication: pricing will need a slight uplift relative to the +8 proposal. I will draft an appendix with exact latency projections, expected token/sec, and fallback routing (hosted smaller context model) for SLA breach scenarios.

Grace — can you validate the KV cache warmup time and whether we can pre-warm during the morning window to reduce cold-start latencies?

-Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

- Term: extend 24 months from MSA renewal date.
- Commitment: reserved uplift to 12 GPUs (10 baseline + 2 burst) with a price tier that holds per-GPU discount consistent with previous commitment bands.
- SLA: 95th percentile throughput guarantee for reranker peak window (220 qps) with credit formula in appendix.
- Onboarding: phased rollout timeline included; implementation kickoff within 7 business days of signature.

2) Provide the procurement signatory and billing PO number.
3) Let us know if the week of 2027-06-07 is acceptable for signature; we will send DocuSign once confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Vesta onboarded with the XL model.
